Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 32 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Shalini - 59 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sunita - 32 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Anita - 30 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The forest - Day

[Sanjay stands in the forest. Shalini, Sunita and Anita stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Sanjay goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Sanjay (excited): "Okay, Mom."

[Sanjay rides an elephant through the forest.]

Shalini: "Sunita, look at this."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Sanjay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Anita: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Sanjay sips red wine.]

Anita: "Hmm, I see."

[Sanjay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Sanjay: "Yes, of course."

[Sanjay and Mother clink their glasses.]

Sanjay: "I really enjoyed today."
